## Overview

In [Module 1](../01-introduction/index.qmd) we got up and running with container
images from public registries such as Docker Hub, GitHub and Quay.io. What if,
however, no public image exists for the software you want to run, or you want to
create a container image for your own software? This module walks through
building and publishing container images using Podman Desktop. Particular
attention is given to creating images that support reproducible outcomes.

## Learning objectives

By the end of this module, you will:

- Know how to authenticate with the GitHub Container Registry
- Understand how a `Containerfile` defines the instructions used to build a
  container image, and know its key instructions
- Be able to write your own containerfiles for simple programs
- Have built and published a container image for a Python program using Podman
- Be able to apply strategies for reproducible and labelled container images
